value: The elemental work leads to Oronok Torn-heart and his farm in Shadowmoon Valley. He does not offer the Cipher’s history at once. In the later telling, he admits that he had tested the seeker and worn the farmer’s role like a cover. His first account begins in ordinary labor; beneath it stands a son and a father whose past reaches back through a shattered world.
editorNote: The quest records Oronok’s test and disclosure. This retelling paraphrases that exchange and does not invent his hidden identity or exact motive.
